findings.current: His cry, unable to escape in a louder voice, was blocked by the internal energy surrounding us and scattered into nothing.
findings.defect: Omits that the surrounding internal energy is the narrator’s, obscuring who contains the cry.
findings.rationale: 내 공력 explicitly identifies Jin Taekyung’s internal energy as what blocks the sound.
findings.replacement: The cry he couldn’t let out at full volume struck the barrier of my internal energy surrounding us and faded away.
findings.source: 미처 큰 소리로 토해 내지 못한 그 외침이, 사방을 둘러싼 내 공력에 가로막혀 덧없이 흩어진다.

findings.current: Ma Sanbao, revealing emotions he’d kept hidden for over a decade, trembled as he pressed his lips together.
findings.defect: Changes quivering lips into the action of pressing them together.
findings.rationale: 입술을 파르르 떨었다 describes his lips trembling, not being pressed together.
findings.replacement: Ma Sanbao’s lips quivered as he revealed emotions he’d kept hidden for over a decade.
findings.source: 지난 십여 년간 숨겨 왔던 감정을 드러낸 마삼보는 입술을 파르르 떨었다.

findings.current: some members of the Embroidered Uniform Guard were heading north in disguise
findings.defect: Specifies a disguise where the source says only that they concealed their identities.
findings.rationale: 정체를 감추고 does not establish that they changed their appearance.
findings.replacement: some members of the Embroidered Uniform Guard were heading north while concealing their identities
findings.source: 금의위 중 일부가 정체를 감추고 북상하고 있다는 정보

findings.current: At least First Rate, and more than half were Peak masters.
findings.defect: Lowers the stated minimum martial rank from Supreme First Rate to First Rate.
findings.rationale: 초일류 is the established Supreme First Rate rank, distinct from 일류.
findings.replacement: Even the weakest were Supreme First Rate, and more than half were Peak masters.

findings.current: But the name was on the level of some neighbor’s dog, Fido.
findings.defect: Turns a crude, ordinary name for a person into the name of an actual dog.
findings.rationale: 옆집 개똥이 refers to a neighboring person with the lowly nickname Gaeddong, not a neighbor’s pet.
findings.replacement: But his name sounded like something you’d call the kid next door: Dogshit.

findings.current: At Ma Sanbao’s sudden remark, I answered, privately wishing I could smack my lips.
findings.defect: Renders an inward reaction of chagrin as a wish to perform a physical action.
findings.rationale: 내심 입맛을 다시며 conveys a private, rueful reaction to being noticed.
findings.replacement: At Ma Sanbao’s sudden remark, I answered, inwardly clicking my tongue.
findings.source: 불쑥 들려온 마삼보의 목소리에, 나는 내심 입맛을 다시며 대답했다.

summary: Several localized fidelity and terminology errors, including a missing agent in the sound-suppression scene and an incorrect martial rank.
